title: A statement line imported after a check-in or after setup, a printed running balance, and a spend that logs itself written late (final_review_1 finding 1, decision O1)
story: Five banks, each opened Mon 4 Jan 2027 with 100,000, so each story stands alone. b1: lunch of 1,000 typed at noon on Wed 6 Jan, the bank checked at 20:00 at 99,000, and the statement line for the lunch imported a week later. b2: the same with no typed line. b3: setup at 12:00 on 4 Jan; a coffee of 500 bought at 8:00 that morning arrives on a statement a week later, and a dinner of 2,000 typed at 19:00 that evening. b4: a check at 20:00 on Fri 8 Jan shows 97,000; the statement imported a week later has two lines that day with its running balance printed: 3,000 (balance 97,000) then 4,000 (balance 93,000). b5: a gym fee of 8,000 logs itself on Fri 8 Jan; the bank was checked at 9:00 that day at 92,000, the gym already taken, and the app wrote the gym spend when it was next opened at 10:00. Every amount is made up.
